purpose: Persistent engineering ledger so architecture, corrections, negative results, implementation decisions and validation gates survive long context windows.

entries.decision: ADV_Elite is simultaneously autonomous room brain, portable personal terminal and smart-home organ.
entries.result: Mission frozen as self-learning predictive environment+swarm system.

entries.decision: M2R is a physics-informed forward World Model / future-state generator; adaptive temporal resolution is subordinate.
entries.correction: Previous framing M2R=only temporal sampling controller was too narrow.

entries.decision: Code 1488 activates M2R active future-simulation mode; Tachyon temporal continuity may remain passive outside it.
Predict WORLD + SWARM + SELF within observability/model boundaries; JANUS itself is part of its world model.
entries.truth_guard: No literal retrocausality/future information access; Dirac-belt language is architectural metaphor only.

entries.decision: JANUS is distributed swarm cognition; ADV_Elite is one autonomous predictive Beacon/Tachyon/M2R organ, not the sole brain.
Every device is an independent solo-capable compute/learning node; swarm connectivity is optional and increases shared data/experience; Habitat is optional heavy compute/archive.
entries.sha256_lane: Parallel adaptive compute lane preserved without changing SHA-256/SHA256d, target or share truth.

entries.decision: A+B memory: continuous Witness + semantic important memory; storage-less nodes offload to capable peers; ordinary old data may be forgotten after value extraction and retention/provenance gates.
Nodes write canonical JANUS-compatible JSON event records directly. Embedded runtime appends one JSON object per line as JSONL/NDJSON; sealed history is ordinary JSON chunk+manifest.
entries.integrity: per-node/session prev_hash -> record_hash; cross-node offload uses provenance + durable ACK.
entries.truth_guard: Hash proves integrity/lineage, not truth of the measurement.

entries.decision: ADV_Elite itself selects KEEP_INTERESTING / ANOMALY / DROP and authors immutable canonical JSON; a trusted gateway authenticates/verifies and performs the privileged GitHub publication.
entries.security: No GitHub credential on ESP32; device-specific gateway auth only.
entries.offline: registry_outbox persists until durable publication ACK

frozen_truth_rules: future data is not available before its timestamp
peer provenance and staleness remain explicit
more nodes provide more data/compute opportunity but do not automatically guarantee better learning
training loss alone is not evidence of improved future prediction
failed predictions and negative experiments are preserved
GitHub publication is not evidence of anomaly causation
